channel.title: Blue Peter
channel.desc: `Blue Peter' becomes Red Peter for the day as the presenters kick off the Red Nose Day celebrations in style. The team are joined by famous faces as they attempt a very messy live world record, Joel finds out about the healing power of horses, the presenters take on an indoor skydiving challenge and singer and `Strictly Come Dancing' star, Fleur East, performs live in the studio.
